basics.name: Klemen Kocic
basics.label: AI Systems Architect
basics.summary: I find where AI fits in real work. I build the systems behind it. I work alongside the people who use them. AI Systems Architect at Luminous Group. Co-architect of Luminosity (an internal multi-agent multi-person production system serving seven people across the company, designed around three coordination layers: Interaction, Coordination, Data). Co-inventor on patents covering multi-agent multi-team coordination. Co-author of eight of the twenty essays on human-AI collaboration at luminousgroup.net/liminality.

work.name: Luminous Group
work.summary: Luminous Group is a human-centred AI consultancy that also builds its own internal AI product, Luminosity. I work both sides: customer engagements and the production system behind them.
highlights: Co-architect of Luminosity, our internal multi-agent multi-person production system serving seven people across the company. Designed around the three-layer system architecture (Interaction, Coordination, Data) behind the company's 'AI that instruments the human' thesis.

Built Luminosity's video production pipeline and the team-coordination workflows that keep the distributed team aligned. Co-built the runtime infrastructure: agent provisioning, MCP tool servers, the rules-and-skills harness, knowledge and context graphs, and ElevenLabs text-to-speech that gives the agents voice.

Built and operate the company's weekly AI-intelligence pipeline: parallel agents collect from across the ecosystem into a Tana knowledge graph that generates concrete action items for each teammate and agent. The system informs partnership decisions, product positioning, and competitive response.

Co-led capability-assessment engagements with senior leaders across healthcare, sport, law, marketing, automotive sales, and architecture. Helped them translate ambiguous AI goals into specific workflows their teams adopted.
Co-inventor on patents covering multi-agent multi-team coordination.

Shape Luminous Group's editorial voice on public surfaces (website, positioning, bios) with the founding team. Co-author of eight of the twenty essays at luminousgroup.net/liminality on human-AI collaboration.

work.name: NHS Personal Training GmbH
highlights: Architected and co-built the full system: React Native (Expo) apps for clients and coaches over a Ruby on Rails + PostgreSQL backend, covering scheduling, training plans, exercise library, invoicing, and point-of-sale with role-based access. Led 6 offshore engineers at 87% on-time release; adopted by every coach and client, still in daily production use.
Built macro/meso-cycle plan generation in our methodology software with an AI layer on top for added support, cutting training-plan creation from 4 hours to 30 minutes.
Built the bilingual corporate website solo, plus 5 partner portals expanding B2B reach.

work.name: MTM Personal Training
highlights: Coached executives and founders one-on-one in a premium studio. Embedded fieldwork that became the domain foundation for Charles (AI strength coach) and the NHS technical lead role that followed.
Built a network of 40+ German founders and CEOs through these coaching relationships. Connections that informed later consulting and product work.

work.name: MetaKing Studios
highlights: Shipped BLOCKLORDS, an online blockchain strategy game that reached $40M in trade volume. Led a 10-person cross-timezone team and cut deployment projection 6 to 4 months at 97% sprint velocity.

Coordinated the team across Jira, Asana, and Miro from architecture to game economy (using Machinations) to the Unity build, plus a Unity-to-blockchain bridge designed to stay non-intrusive so players never had to touch the on-chain layer to enjoy the game.

Owned go-to-market for the BLOCKLORDS launch: marketing materials, community activation across Discord, Telegram, and X, partnerships with Web3 gaming guilds, launch-day coordination across regions, and on-chain growth tracking after launch.
Built Grafana and Tableau dashboards for on-chain analytics, giving leadership real-time visibility into game-economy health and player behaviour.

work.name: Seascape Network
highlights: Shipped 5 gaming project launches across Ethereum, Polygon, and BSC. Managed Lighthouse, a fund-generating platform supporting 10+ external game developers. Negotiated ~$500K investor funding, extending runway ~9 months.
Built KPI tracking dashboards in SQL + Tableau on top of on-chain event data, giving leadership real-time visibility into ecosystem health.

work.name: Seascape Network
highlights: Analyzed user and wallet growth to inform product launches and partnership priorities.
Partner ecosystem insights contributed to 30+ integrations and MAU growth from ~10K to ~56K.
Built repeatable KPI tracking to support leadership planning and investor reporting.

publications.name: They Built It. They Can't Control It.
publications.summary: The largest AI companies keep losing control of their own systems. AI-generated code deployed without adequate human review. Argues the failures are architectural, not technological. Co-written with Barton Friedland and Jim Highsmith.

publications.name: What You Govern Determines What You Become
publications.summary: AI systems optimise what is specified; they do not determine what ought to be specified. Incomplete objectives compound at scale.

publications.name: The Resolution of Intelligence
publications.summary: AI integration often erodes human judgement rather than enhancing it. The most valuable organisations preserve and elevate human authorship.

publications.name: What Agents Cannot Want
publications.summary: When execution becomes abundant, scarcity migrates upward — to human intent: deciding which things deserve to exist.

publications.name: The Displacement of Judgement
publications.summary: Modern organisations have moved consequential decision-making away from human judgement. Formative vs corrective intervention as the redesign lever. Co-written with Barton Friedland.

publications.name: Open the Window
publications.summary: Using AI at work is not cheating when it is used to augment human judgment, not replace it. A framework for organisations to permit, equip, and audit AI-assisted work.

publications.name: More Than a Mirror
publications.summary: Bring vague questions and thin knowledge, and AI will upscale your vagueness. The Augmentation Arc: Mirror, Lens, Lighthouse, Prism.

publications.name: The Racing Yacht
publications.summary: Steve Jobs called the computer a 'bicycle for the mind.' That metaphor no longer fits. Augmentation requires collective intelligence.

projects.name: Charles
projects.description: AI strength-training coach for iOS. Periodised programmes that rebuild session by session as the user logs what actually happened. Flutter + Supabase + pgvector. Two-layer architecture: relational gym data on Layer 1, vector-backed AI knowledge on Layer 2. Multi-model orchestration (Claude, Gemini, swappable). Six deterministic filter layers before the model ever sees the data.
highlights: Built end-to-end with co-founder: data model, periodisation logic, feedback loop, multi-model orchestration, filtering pipeline.
